bukkit.summary: The plugin server Spigot is built on, without its speed-ups. Pick Spigot unless you need this exactly.

fabric.summary: A light, fast-moving mod loader. Usually the first to support a new Minecraft version.

folia.summary: Paper spread across CPU cores, for very large worlds. Only plugins made for Folia will work.

neoforge.summary: Mod loader for big, content-heavy modpacks. The first launch prepares the game files, so it takes a few minutes.

paper.summary: A faster server that runs Bukkit plugins, tuned by the Paper team for each version.

spigot.summary: The classic plugin server, with the largest plugin library. Nobody may hand it out ready-made, so Hestia builds it here the first time — allow a few minutes.

vanilla.summary: Mojang's game, unchanged. Takes datapacks only — no mods or plugins.

hotbars.hint: The hotbars saved in creative mode.
hotbars.label: Creative hotbars

options.hint: Keybinds, video and audio, merged setting by setting.
options.label: Game settings

resource_packs.hint: Installed into every instance a pack fits.
resource_packs.label: Resource packs

screenshots.hint: Read where they were taken; nothing is copied.
screenshots.label: Screenshots

servers.hint: The servers in the in-game list.
servers.label: Multiplayer list
